questions.question: If the sum of the squares of two positive numbers is 2426 and the square root of one number is 7, then the other number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the squares of two positive numbers = 2426

The square root of one number = 7

**Calculation:**

Let numbers be x and y

⇒ √x = 7

⇒ x = 49

According to the question

⇒ x² + y² = 2426

⇒ (49)² + y2 = 2426

⇒ y2 = 2426 - 2401

⇒ y2 = 25

**∴ The other number is 5.**

questions.question: A sum invested at 8% p.a. amounts to Rs. 20,280 at the end of one year, when the interest is compounded half-yearly. what will be the compound interest (in Rs.) on the same sum for 2 years if the interest rate is the same as earlier and interest is compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum invested at 8% p.a. amounts to Rs. 20,280 at the end of one year, when the interest is compounded half-yearly.

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿT

A = Amount, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time

n = number of times interest compounded per year

**Calculation:**

Let Principal be Rs P

Interest is compounded half-yearly

⇒ Rate = 8/2 = 4%

According to the question

⇒ P(1 + (4)/(100) )² = 20280

⇒ P(104/100)² = 20280

⇒ P(26/25)² = 20280

⇒ P = (20280 × 25 × 25)/(26 × 26) = 18750 Rs

Again, according to the question

⇒ Amount = 18750(1 + (8)/(100))²

⇒ Amount = (18750 × 27 × 27)/(25 × 25) = 21870 Rs

⇒ CI = 21870 - 18750 = 3120

**∴ Compound interest for 2 years at the same rate is 3120 Rs.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at 20% above the cost price. He sells three - fourth of the goods at the marked price and the remaining at 30% discount on the marked price. What is his gain/loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper marks his goods at 20% above the CP.

He sells three-fourth of the goods at the MP and the remaining at 30% discount on the MP.

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP × (100-D)/(100)

MP = Marked Price, SP = Selling Price, D = Discount

**Calculation:**

Let CP be Rs Y

⇒ MP = Y × (120)/(100)

SP of 3/4 goods = (3)/(4) × (120)/(100)Y

questions.question: A borrows a sum of Rs.9,000 for 3 years at 5% simple interest. He lends it at simple interest to B at 7% for 3 years. What is his gain (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A borrows a sum of Rs.9,000 for 3 years at 5% simple interest

He lends it at simple interest to B at 7% for 3 years

**Formula Used**:

SI = (P × R × T)/100

SI = Simple Interest, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time

**Calculation**:

According to the question

SI = (9000 × 3 × 5)/100 = 1350 Rs

A lends to B at 7% for 3 years

SI = (9000 × 7 × 3)/100 = 1890 Rs

Profit = 1890 - 1350 = 540 Rs

**∴ His gain is 540 Rs.**

questions.question: A train covers 400 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 10 km/h more, it would have taken 2 hours less for the same journey. What is the speed of the train (in km/h)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

We can answer this question by looking at the options

Option 4: Initial Speed = 40 km/hr, Increased Speed = 50 km/hrInitial Time = 400/40 = 10 hrs, New Time = 400/50 = 8 hrs

The given condition is satisfied

∴ The speed of the train is 40 km/hr.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance = 400 km

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let speed be x km/hr

According to the question

(400)/(x) - (400)/(x+10) = 2 hours

⇒ 400 ((1)/(x) - (1)/(x+10)) = 2 

⇒ (1)/(x) - (1)/(x+10) = (2)/(400)

⇒ frac{{10}}{{{x² } + 10x}}= (1)/(200)

⇒ {x²} + 10x - 2000 = 0

⇒ {x²} + 50x - 40x - 2000 = 0

⇒ x(x + 50) - 40(x + 50) = 0

⇒ (x + 50) (x - 40) = 0

⇒ x = 40 or -50

But speed can not be negative

**∴ The speed of the train is 40 km/hr.**

questions.question: A is 5 times as good a workman as B and is therefore able to complete a job in 52 days less than B. In how many days will they complete it working together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is 5 times as good a workman as B

A complete a job in 52 days less than B

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Total efficiency × Total days

**Calculation:**

 The ratio of efficiency of A & B is 5 : 1

Thus, the ratio of time of A & B is 1 : 5

Let time taken by A and B be T and 5T respectively

According to the question

⇒ 5T - T = 52 days

⇒ 4T = 52 days

⇒ T = 13 days

Total work = 13 × 5 = 65 units

A and B complete the work in 65/6 days

 **∴ While working together A & B will complete the work in 10(5)/(6) days.**

questions.question: The average of n numbers is 36. If each of 75% of the numbers is increased by 5 and each of the remaining numbers is decreased by 8, then the new average of the numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Average of 75% number increases by 5

Average of 25% numbers decreases by 8

By mixture and Allegation method

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1355b73c00c99ed6d2e3be2581c3ba087b127f29f49a80c015b1ced49f7717e3.png] 

Thus, the overall average increases by 1.75

⇒ New average = 36 + 1.75 = 37.5

∴ The new average of the total numbers is 37.75.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The average of n number is 36

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of total observations ÷ Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let n be 100

According to the question

Each of 75% of the numbers is increased by 5

New average of 75% of the numbers = 36 + 5 = 41

Sum of 75% of the numbers = 75 × 41 = 3075

Again, according to the question

Remaining numbers = 100 - 75 = 25

Average of remaining numbers decrease by 8

New average = (36 - 8) = 28

Sum of remaining numbers = 25 × 28 = 700

New average of all numbers = (3075 + 700) ÷ 100

⇒ (3075 + 700) ÷ 100 = 37.75

**∴ The new average of the total numbers is 37.75.**

Old Price = New Price × (100)/(75) = 30 × (100)/(75) = ₹40 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

The price of sugar is reduced by 25%

Radha is able to buy 10 kg sugar more for ₹ 1,200

**Concept Used:**

To maintain the expenditure

Change in price of a commodity ∝ (1)/(Consumption)

**Calculation:**

Let the original price of sugar be ₹P

Quantity of sugar = (1200)/(P)

Reduced price = (100 – 25)/(100) × P = (3)/(4)P

Increased quantity of sugar = (1200)/((3/4)P) = (1600)/(P)

According to question

(1600/P) – (1200/P) = 10

⇒ 10P = 400

⇒ P = ₹40

 **∴** **The original price of sugar per kg is ₹40.**

questions.question: The length of a rectangle is (2)/(5) of the radius of a circle. The radius of the circle is equal to the side of a square whose area is 4900 m². What is the area (in m²) of the rectangle, if its breadth is 20 m?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Side of square** = √4900 = 70 m.

**Radius of circle** = Side = 70 m.

**Length of rectangle** = (2/5) × 70 = 28 m.

**Area of rectangle** = 28 × 20 = 560 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 560 m².**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f1f949026147f1aa83edff5c1ae2e2e4891d0ff4a215eeda3b4ef65f926e1a2.png] 

Given: **Area of square** = 4900 m², **Breadth of rectangle** = 20 m.

Formula used: **Area of square** = side²; **Area of rectangle** = **Length** × **Breadth**.

⇒ Side of **square** (s) = √4900

⇒ s = 70 m

⇒ **Radius of circle** (r) = Side of square = 70 m

⇒ **Length** of **rectangle** (L) = (2/5) × 70

⇒ L = 2 × 14 = 28 m

⇒ **Area** of **rectangle** = L × Breadth

⇒ **Area** = 28 × 20 = 560 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 560 m².**

**__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Square

A **square** has all sides equal. Area = side² and Perimeter = 4 × side.

Properties of a Rectangle

A **rectangle** has opposite sides equal. Area = Length × Breadth and Perimeter = 2(Length + Breadth).

Circle Relations

The **radius** (r) is the distance from the center to the edge. Area = πr² and Circumference = 2πr.</p

questions.question: In an election, the votes cast for two candidates are in the ratio 3 : 10. If all votes are valid votes and if the successful candidates received 156200 votes, then the total votes polled are:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Votes received by two candidates in terms of ratio = 3 : 10

Total votes received by successful candidate = 156200

**Calculation:**

Let the votes got by two candidates be 3x & 10x

10x = 156200

⇒ x = 15620

Total votes polled = 3x + 10x

⇒ 13 × 15620 = 203060

**∴**** The total votes polled are 203060.**

questions.question: If the radius of a circle is increased by 10% then what is the percentage increase in its area?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a circle is increased by 10%

**Formula Used:**

Area of circle = πr²

Percentage change = ((Final Value pm Initial Value)/(Initial Value)) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the Initial radius be r

Initial area = πr²

Increased radius = (100+10)/(100) × r = 1.1r

New area = π(1.1r)²

Percentage increase =(π(1.21)r² – πr²)/(πr²) × 100

Percentage increase = (πr²(1.21-1))/(πr²) × 100 = 21%

**∴** **The percentage increase in the area of circle is 21%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Apply successive formula

Y + Y + (Ytimes Y)/(100) = 10 + 10 + (10times 10)/(100) = 21%

**∴** **The percentage increase in its area is 21%.**
